text:
lina.partners: Quick sync request 2: Gaudi + MI300 launch wave. Need a compact readiness checklist we can hand off to marketplace, SI, and press. Can we avoid duplicate artifacts across teams?

omar-hw: I can consolidate HW items. Request: vendor-signed firmware hash + kernel module tag + bench power logs. Will need lab window to re-run thermal tests.

nina.prod: Marketplace needs: tile metadata, pricing slug, supported instance shapes, and a fallback note for customers. Also: legal wants embargo windows nailed down.

ryan-devex: Devex asks: canonical quickstart, example infra-as-code for mounting devices, and a CI smoke that validates tokenized perf. I'll add a tested `docker-compose` example.

tess-oncall: Ops: define routing fallbacks. Propose rule: when MI300 regional capacity below 15% route to H200/B200 variants; if latency spike >20% then divert to gaudi-compatible with degraded SLO. Need acceptance criteria.

lina.partners: Good. Let's capture owners here. Also post any vendor contacts.

omar-hw: Owners: HW artifacts -> omar-hw; power/thermal logs -> infra; vendor contacts -> I'll DM. Vendors: habana: raj@habana, nvidia: maria@nvidia, amd: lucas@amd.

nina.prod: Owners: marketplace tile + pricing -> nina.prod; legal/embargo -> legal@redwood. Add a customer-facing fallback paragraph to the tile.

ryan-devex: Owners: quickstart + IaC examples -> ryan-devex. I'll include a small smoke script:
```
# smoke perf check
python tools/smoke.py --model "alpaca-7b" --seq 1024 --batch 1 --target-p50 140
```
Will make CI job `ci/marketplace/gaudi-mi300/smoke`.

tess-oncall: Ops snippet for routing (pseudo):
```
if capacity(region, "mi300") < 0.15:
  route_to = ["h200_fallback","b200_fallback"]
elif p50_delta > 0.2:
  route_to = ["gaudi_compat_degraded"]
```
We should add a fallback latency expectation block in the tile.

lina.partners: Timeline: draft mapping by Wed EOD, full cert artifacts by Fri EOD. Push a 20-min sync Thu 9:00 to check vendor blockers.

omar-hw: Heads-up: Habana flagged a microcode revision that could shift our week-of-May freeze. If that slips we need an embargo extension. I'll update when vendor confirms.

nina.prod: Marketplace tile example I'll produce (YAML) 2:
```yaml
sku: rw-gaudi-48g-v2
supported_instances:
  - gaudi-48g
  - mi300-64g
fallback_guidance: |
  If MI300 capacity is limited, workload will route to H200/B200 variants where supported. Performance and latency may vary.
embargo_window: 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-07
owner: nina.prod
```

ryan-devex: CI bot note: `ci/marketplace/gaudi-mi300/smoke` created (status: pending). Will attach smoke thresholds and logs to sheet.

tess-oncall: INFRA ask: need `lab-image: power-profile-v3` tag for vendor thermal repro. Filed INFRA-4919.

lina.partners: Action items recap:
- Omar: vendor intros + HW artifacts + freeze dates (owner)
- Nina: marketplace tile + embargo copy + fallback paragraph (owner)
- Ryan: quickstart + IaC + CI smoke (owner)
- Tess: ops routing playbook + INFRA ticket follow-up (owner)
- Lina: comms + press handoff + sync scheduling (owner)

omar-hw: I'll DM vendor contacts after this thread and post an intro summary.

nina.prod: I'll draft the tile and share link in the partnership sheet.

ryan-devex: Starting the quickstart now, aim PR by Wed.

tess-oncall: INFRA-4919 created, assigned to infra-team. I'll link when ready.

lina.partners: Thanks all. Please update the partnership sheet under "Gaudi-MI300 Onramp" and ping if anything will miss the Wed EOD draft. :thumbsup: 

announce-bot: Reminder set: Meeting Thu 09:00 (20m) "Gaudi/MI300 readiness check".
